basis: At the 2016-03 filing Garry Tan was managing partner of Initialized Capital (YC partner 2011-2015, YC CEO only from Jan 2023), and his director seat at Andrew Lee's Esper scheduling-assistant startup came with Initialized's seed alongside 8VC and Khosla; no YC fund and no YC batch entry.

The 2017-02 round was a $4M seed led by Initialized Capital, and the coverage states explicitly that Initialized managing partner Garry Tan joined the board as a result, so the seat is Initialized's and not YC's.

Garry Tan's 2018 seat was Initialized Capital's (he led the $11.6M Series A), but Egomotion Corp is the legal entity of Zeus Living (Kulveer Taggar and Srini Panguluri, 729 Minna St SF; Trinity Capital books 'Egomotion Corporation' under Real Estate), and YC's own directory lists it as Zeus, Summer 2011, former names Status/Agent/Tagstand, so a YC fund holds the position through the batch.

Initialized Capital's own write-up says Garry Tan led Formic's seed while at Initialized (2021-03 filing), founder Saman Farid came from Baidu Ventures rather than a batch, and Formic appears nowhere in YC's company directory.
Trunk.io's $25M Series A of 2022-03 was led by Initialized Capital (Garry Tan) with a16z, ten months before Tan returned to YC as CEO, and Trunk is not a YC batch company.

Alphonso Labs is Pulse News, Ankit Gupta's OWN Stanford-born company (he signs as co-founder/officer beside Akshay Kothari, with NEA's Patrick Chung as the 2011 director) and this is a different person from YC's partner Ankit Gupta, the Reverie Labs (W18) founder.

The same Pulse/LinkedIn Ankit Gupta founded Bicycle Health and signs all three filings as its CEO, with Questa Capital's Ryan Drant on the board; his firm at filing time is Bicycle Health itself, and YC's roster Ankit Gupta (Reverie Labs W18, Ginkgo) is a different person.

This is a third, Bangalore-based Ankit Gupta who co-founded Quizizz with Deepak Cheenath; the 2021-02 filing is their $12.5M Series A led by Eight Roads with Nexus and Prime Venture Partners (director Shripati Acharya), with no YC fund and no batch listing.

Eric LeVine signs both filings as founder-CEO of his own Seattle wine-cellar company, which he built after leaving Microsoft in 2004; YC's roster Eric Levine is the Berbix (S18) co-founder and Clawvisor founder, a different person, and no YC fund is on the round.

A director-only seat on a $1,250 nominal filing by an Arizona auto-repair lender run by Neeraj Mehta, alongside auto and fintech operators; nothing ties it to YC's Eric Levine (Berbix S18, ex-Airbnb) and no YC fund appears, so it is the personal-seat class.

Groupay, Inc. is GoCardless's Delaware entity (filed c/o GoCardless Ltd, London, by founders Blomfield, Matt Robinson and Hiroki Takeuchi), and GoCardless is a YC Summer 2011 batch company, so a YC fund is behind the position; Blomfield's own YC group-partner role only began in 2023.
In 2009 Dalton Caldwell was imeem's own founder-CEO, with Sequoia's Mark Kvamme and Morgenthaler's Ken Gullicksen on the board; he did not join YC as a partner until 2013.

Brad Flora was NowSpots' own founder in 2010 (he became a YC visiting group partner only in 2019), but NowSpots is the company that became Perfect Audience, which YC's directory carries as a Summer 2011 batch company, so a YC fund invested.

Across 2012-2016 Surbhi Sarna was nVision Medical's own founder-CEO, with Catalyst Health Ventures, LMNVC and EXXclaim directors on the filings and Boston Scientific buying the company in 2018; she joined YC as a visiting partner in 2020 and group partner in Nov 2021.

Tyler Bosmeny is listed only as an Executive Officer of PaperG, the Yale-founded ad-tech company where he was VP of Sales in 2009-2012 (directors from Launch Capital); he founded Clever (YC S12) afterwards and became a YC partner only in 2023.

EDGAR shows CIK 1556846 was renamed from Xulu, Inc. to FutureAdvisor, Inc., the YC Summer 2010 company Jon Xu co-founded with Bo Lu (both on the 2014 filing with Sequoia's Warren Hogarth), so the rows are FutureAdvisor's own rounds and a YC fund is behind the position.
